source: Derived from .claude/skills/brand-design-systems/brands/sentry.md (deep violet-midnight canvas, electric-lime keyword highlight, chunky display sans with Space Grotesk as the stated open substitute, Rubik-for-UI mapped to Inter).

token_notes.canvas: #1F1633 is Sentry's surface-canvas-dark (deep violet midnight). Chosen over a neutral near-black so the run reads distinct from the recent steel and pure-black dark videos.
token_notes.accent: #C2EF4E is Sentry's electric lime, its signature keyword-highlight color. It clears 12.9:1 on the violet canvas, well past the 4.5 mono-aesthetic floor.
token_notes.fonts: Sentry's proprietary chunky display sans is unavailable. Space Grotesk is the brand doc's own stated open substitute. Inter stands in for Rubik on the UI tier.
